reason: Spanish hard-enduro rider with a 2026 Hixpania win (FIM Hard Enduro World Championship round 8, final round), a 2022 championship runner-up place and a 2026 move to his own MR74 Racing Team. Several sources agree on the core career facts.

birthDate.note: Only Endurowow gives the exact day. The Palencia en la Red interview (published 20/10/2024) quotes him as 34 years old, which fits a 1990 birth year. A search snippet from another database lists 16 January 1991, which was not opened and is not used.

birthPlace.note: Endurowow gives Madrid as place of birth. Telemadrid calls him a Madrid native (madrileño) without stating the birthplace. No source gives Palencia.

nationality.note: Endurowow lists Spain. The interview calls him the top Spanish representative in the world championship.

gapNote: The available coverage is race reports for the 2026 Hixpania final. Little of it places that win in his career: the Sherco years (2017 to 2025), the 2022 world championship runner-up place, the 2018 Hixpania win, and the 2026 move to his own MR74 Racing Team on a Husqvarna TE 300. A page that sets those turning points out with sourced dates can answer the career question better than race-day reports. No official FIM or organizer results page was reachable, so the result rests on press reports that agree with each other.
